test.create_query: CREATE TABLE perf_has_chain (id UInt64, tags Array(String), tags_lc Array(LowCardinality(String)), nums Array(UInt64)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO perf_has_chain SELECT number, tags, tags, arrayMap(x -> cityHash64(number, x) % 1000, range(3 + number % 8)) FROM (SELECT number, arrayMap(x -> concat('tag', toString(toUInt32(floor(pow(200000, (cityHash64(number, x) % 1000000) / 1000000.0))))), range(3 + number % 8)) AS tags FROM numbers(10000000)) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1
